lines: A flag or a suspension can now be undone. Staff reinstate a member from the same dialog.
For a flagged member, Reinstate comes first, the milder choice. It asks for no note.
One press, and the member is Active again, with the old note cleared from their row.
A suspended member can only be reinstated. The dialog says what that means, before anything happens.
A toast confirms it, and the list shows them Active.
On the server, sign-in opens again. Sessions that the suspension ended stay ended.
The same rules hold: not your own account, and only an Admin for staff.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
That's slice twenty-seven point two. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
